2026-11-13 16:33:22.789084 | controller |
2026-11-13 16:33:22.789087 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-13 16:33:22.789091 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-13 16:33:22.789094 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-13 16:33:22.789097 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-13 16:33:22.789100 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-13 16:33:22.789103 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-11-13 16:33:22.789106 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
